items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: So I seen right smack there where Al G. Barnes was going to New Orleans and Baton Rouge.

ctx.x: No, but then they had a side-show, they called it, where they had small combos, and it always had a kind of minstrel show with them -- and you played for them. The minstrel show had maybe two or three guys in it, I don't know...

So anyway, I looked in the... The Billboard showed the routes of all the different circuses, too, where they was going, and the dates. So I seen right smack there where Al G. Barnes was going to New Orleans and Baton Rouge.
